intent: Wire check_shell_coverage.sh into pre-commit so the shell ratchet cannot silently rot, and give the coverage tooling itself the suite it was missing.
scope: meta/scripts/check_shell_coverage.sh (stale message referencing a removed constant)
meta/scripts/lib/tests/ (new suite: harness + 3 test files + run_all.sh)
changes: Added the shell-coverage-ratchet hook, types: [shell], excluding third_party/. It was previously never wired, so a new untested shell library could land freely.

FIX: check_shell_coverage.sh line 177 interpolated ${COVERAGE_BAR}, which no longer exists after 578c4a6c, producing 'COVERAGE_BAR: unbound variable' on every failure path. The message now describes the presence bar it actually enforces.

New suite for the three meta/scripts/lib coverage-tooling libs, which are the one corner of the repo the jail cannot measure itself: 48 assertions over is_covered, build_jail, write_cases, build_mount_script, reconcile_pass_failures and write_case_runner.

Assertions on unexpanded ${BASH_SOURCE}/$1 literals compose the dollar sign from an exported DOLLAR constant rather than writing single-quoted literals, so the files are SC2016-clean with no suppressions.

verification.evidence: Passed in 0.16s; check_shell_coverage.sh --all now reports 0 BLOCK entries, down from 3, and runs in 0.31s

verification.command: Created an untested lib at mtk_root/lib/zz_probe.sh and ran the hook on it
verification.evidence: Hook failed with 'needs: linux_configuration/scripts/mtk_root/lib/tests/run_all.sh'. Probe file removed; the ratchet is not toothless.

verification.command: shellcheck -x and shfmt -l over the new files

risks: The hook now runs on every commit touching a shell file. Measured at 0.16s repo-wide, so the cost is negligible.
A lib added to a directory that has no suite is now blocked at commit time. That is the intended ratchet behaviour, and all 8 such directories are already allowlisted.
rollback: Remove the shell-coverage-ratchet block from .pre-commit-config.yaml; the gate returns to being unenforced.
After rollback, confirm `pre-commit run --all-files` no longer lists the hook.
